name: Wonderwright
summary:
Open a treasure chest on your desk and a wonder of the world tumbles out in pieces. Pick them up, turn them in your hands and build it the way it was really built: arches before the keystone, buttresses before the vaults, the central pillar before the pagoda roofs.

When the last piece clicks in, your model rises on its walnut plinth. Then step through and stand inside the real thing, at life size, under a real sky, with a guide who tells you what you are looking at.

- 15 wonders: the Colosseum, the Great
